title: What is Navigation?
overview: Navigation allows users to move between different screens in a React Native application. It manages screen transitions, routes, and navigation history.

example.title: Navigation Example
example.content:
Common screens:
• Login Screen
• Home Screen
• Profile Screen
• Settings Screen

title: React Navigation Library
overview: React Navigation is the most commonly used navigation library in React Native. It provides tools to create stack, tab, and drawer navigation systems.

example.title: Installation
example.content:
npm install @react-navigation/native

React Navigation provides:
• Stack Navigator
• Tab Navigator
• Drawer Navigator

title: Navigation Container
overview: NavigationContainer manages the navigation state of the application. It should wrap the complete navigation structure and is usually added in the App component.

title: Stack Navigation
overview: Stack Navigation allows users to move between screens in a stack format. New screens are added on top of previous screens and users can go back to the previous screen.

example.title: Stack Example
example.content:
Login
  ↓
Home
  ↓
Profile

User can navigate back through the stack.

title: Navigating Between Screens
overview: The navigation object provides methods to move between screens. The navigate method is used to open another screen.

title: Passing Parameters Between Screens
overview: Navigation allows passing data from one screen to another using parameters. This is useful when a screen needs information from the previous screen.

title: Tab Navigation
overview: Tab navigation is used when an application has multiple main sections. Users can switch between screens using tabs at the bottom or top of the application.

example.title: Tab Example
example.content:
Common Tabs:
• Home
• Search
• Profile
• Settings

title: Drawer Navigation
overview: Drawer navigation provides a side menu that allows users to access different sections of an application. It is commonly used for applications with many screens.

example.title: Drawer Example
example.content:
Drawer Menu:
• Dashboard
• Profile
• Notifications
• Logout

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how navigation works in React Native, how to use React Navigation, create stack, tab, and drawer navigation, move between screens, and pass data between screens.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Navigation manages screen movement.
✔ NavigationContainer manages navigation state.
✔ Stack handles screen history.
✔ Tabs switch main sections.
✔ Params pass data between screens.
